idea-plugin.name: OpenCode Terminal Launcher
idea-plugin.description:
OpenCode Terminal Launcher

A fast, seamless IntelliJ IDEA extension that adds a header toolbar button and a dedicated keyboard shortcut to open the integrated terminal and run the opencode CLI directly in your active project workspace.

✨ Key Features

  • Header Toolbar Action: Accessible directly from the top-right header toolbar (MainToolbarRight in Modern UI).
  • Keyboard Shortcut: Quick trigger using Cmd+Option+O (macOS) or Ctrl+Alt+O (Windows/Linux).
  • Integrated Terminal: Opens a dedicated terminal tab titled OpenCode pointing to the current project root path.
  • Theme Aware: Features the official OpenCode logo with automatic light and dark IDE theme switching.

🌐 Source Code & Repository

Developed by João Alves (j-nart).
GitHub Repository: https://github.com/joaonart/intellij-opencode-plugin

⌨️ Default Keyboard Shortcut

  • macOS: Cmd + Option + O
  • Windows / Linux: Ctrl + Alt + O

⚠️ Unofficial Plugin Disclaimer: This is an independent, community-developed plugin created by João Alves (j-nart) and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially associated with OpenCode.
